name: hud_ui_mgr_set_nanite_panel_count
description: HudUiMgr::SetNanitePanelCount forwards the nanite count to the global nanite triplet panel.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native nanite-panel forwarding tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x411750 validates the direct call to HudUiTripletPanel::SetVisibleCount on g_HudUiMgr.nanitePanel with the incoming count.
The native triplet-panel smoke verifies HudUiMgr::SetNanitePanelCount forwards the count to g_HudUiMgrNanitePanel and applies the same child visibility and invalidation behavior.
